description: Team DeHa Space is a group of high-school students and a teacher mentor from Türkiye. For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 we built Mission Architect, a bilingual (Turkish/English) 3D browser game for the Space Mission Design Game challenge. Players design a Moon or Mars mission, launch it, fix a failure in orbit, run a surface base and bring the crew home, learning real trade-offs with NASA data along the way.
